title: Human-centered evaluation of data visualization understanding in vision-language models
abstract: arXiv:2505.17202v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Data visualization understanding, which requires integrating visual, numerical, and linguistic inputs, poses fundamental challenges to multimodal reasoning. Recently developed vision-language models (VLMs) are promising candidates for modeling the computations that underlie human data visualization understanding. However, whether they are useful as scientific models depends not only on whether they produce correct answers, but also whether they approximate the patterns of responses that people produce on the same tasks. This distinction has been ignored in recent evaluations of VLMs, which typically only report overall model performance (accuracy) without direct comparison to human behavioral patterns. Here we introduce a human-centered evaluation protocol that compares VLM and human responses on the same set of visualization understanding items. We apply this protocol to eight VLMs across six assessments: five established test

translated_title: 视觉语言模型中数据可视化理解的以人为中心的评估
translated_abstract: 数据可视化理解需要整合视觉、数值和语言输入，对多模态推理提出了根本性的挑战。最近开发的视觉语言模型（VLMs）是建模人类数据可视化理解背后计算过程的有潜力的候选者。然而，它们作为科学模型是否有用，不仅取决于能否给出正确答案，还取决于它们能否近似人类在相同任务上产生的反应模式。这一区别在近期的VLM评估中被忽视了，这些评估通常只报告模型的整体表现（准确率），而没有与人类行为模式进行直接比较。本文引入了一种以人为中心的评估协议，在相同的一组可视化理解题目上比较VLM与人类的反应。我们将该协议应用于八个VLM在六项评估中的表现：五项已建立的测试……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种以人为中心的评估协议，通过在相同的数据可视化理解任务上直接比较视觉语言模型与人类的反应模式，弥补了以往仅依赖准确率评估的不足。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces a human-centered evaluation protocol that directly compares vision-language models' responses with human behavioral patterns on the same data visualization understanding tasks, going beyond the accuracy-only evaluations of prior work.
